settings.title: Team-Focused Training for Players Looking to Level Up Together

settings.editor: Group Training at Pickyard offers a social, dynamic environment where players of similar skill levels train together, push one another, and progress faster. These sessions combine structured drills, tactical exercises, and match play led by experienced coaches who focus on improving technique, strategy, and on-court decision-making.
Each session brings a mix of intensity, teamwork, and progression, designed to help players develop more complete and adaptive games.

settings.description_text: Targeted exercises to improve consistency, control, and shot quality.
Learn winning patterns, court positioning, and decision-making as a doubles team.
Practice real match scenarios with coach feedback to accelerate improvement.
High-repetition gameplay ensures you stay engaged and continually challenged.

settings.editor: Group Training attracts players who enjoy working toward improvement in a shared environment. Whether you're preparing for tournaments or simply want to play better with friends, these sessions help refine your technique, sharpen your strategic thinking, and boost overall confidence on the court.

settings.testimonial_content: "The training significantly improved my batting technique and overall game strategy."

settings.editor: Athletes love the shared motivation, fast-paced drills, and consistent feedback from our coaches. The environment encourages camaraderie, friendly competition, and measurable progress. You’ll leave every session feeling stronger, smarter, and more connected to the Pickyard community.

items.item_title: What happens during a group training session?
What skill levels can join Group Training?
Do I need to come with a partner?
Can I combine Group Training with private coaching?

settings.editor: Group Training combines drills, gameplay scenarios, footwork routines, and match-based practice. Sessions are designed to improve technique, reaction speed, teamwork, and on-court decision-making in a dynamic format.

We organize groups by level — beginner, intermediate, and advanced — so everyone trains in a balanced, competitive environment. This ensures partners and opponents match your pace and challenge level.
No partner is needed. We rotate players throughout the session so you can experience different playing styles and learn how to adapt strategically.

If you’re unsure, our coaching team can evaluate your experience level in just a few minutes. We’ll place you in a beginner group that fits your comfort level and goals.Absolutely. Many players see faster improvement by attending both. Private sessions refine your technique, while group training helps you apply skills in real-game situations.
Find a session that matches your level and start training with players who push you to improve.
